note: The anchored span 89-93 is exactly the late width check that the cited fix removes and replaces with a pre-write bound. Admitted by the batch.

rows.reason: The only width guard ran after BitWriterUtils.WriteBits had already written the untrusted run into buffer, so an oversized Modified Huffman run overflows the destination span before the check at 90-92 can throw (CWE-787). The cited fix removes this post-hoc check and adds the bound before WriteBits; frozen 89-93 is the removed block.
